card.name: The word once in dosing frequency
card.fires_on: The word once (or daily after once) right after a route such as subcutaneously or orally in a recommended-dosage statement. It also fires weakly on the number or percent sign in rates like 100 person-years or 75%-100%.

modes.label: Once after route
modes.description: The word once or daily follows the route of administration in a dosage sentence.
modes.example: The recommended dosage of LEROCHOL is 300 mg administered subcutaneously<< once>> monthly.

modes.label: End of a numeric range or rate
modes.description: A zero or percent sign closes a number in a rate or percentage range.
modes.example: discoloration of the conjunctivae, tears, sweat, sputum, urine and feces in 75%-100<<%>> of patients.

card.plain: It marks the spot in a dosage line where the dosing interval, like once monthly, is about to be stated.
